expectations.text: States each scroll is read for 30 days before moving to the next
Gives the three daily readings: silently on rising, silently after the midday meal, aloud before retiring
Explains the purpose: forming good habits / reaching the subconscious ('other mind') through repetition
Notes the first scroll's law: form good habits and become their slave (only a habit subdues a habit)
Mentions not skipping a day and/or the ~10 month total
Lists or references the ten scroll themes (love, persist, miracle, last day, emotions, laugh, multiply value, act now, prayer)
